evidence_excerpt: - role: read channel metrics, separate reach vs conversion, propose experiments and packaging changes
1. Shorts feed is the dominant distribution surface.
2. The audience is mostly unsubscribed, so the channel has discovery but weak conversion.
3. Concrete workplace-problem videos drive reach best.
4. Emotionally sharp identity-level topics appear better at subscriber conversion.
5. LinkedIn is a plausible secondary distribution surface for this niche.
## Recommended operating split for next 7 uploads

winning_themes: concrete operational frictions / ordinary objects — budget cut, dirty mug, expense receipt, and checklist-style triggers outperformed abstract stoic framing; keep the repeatable method but vary objects/processes
criticism / feedback without defensiveness — client criticism had strong views and likes; use sparingly with different actors/situations to avoid conflict over-clustering
attention-control systems — 11-minute interruption/focus and decision-loop posts performed steadily; make these about actual workflows, not generic anxiety
resource constraints / doing useful work with less — budget cut was the strongest current-week post and coincided with the biggest follower gain day
ambition / promotion / desire control — promotion post had high likes and good views; use as a counterweight to conflict/pressure topics
